verdict.rationale: Notion's integrations directory lists a GitHub connection to "keep your GitHub and Notion workflows in sync" (notion-docs-17), but nothing shows that the sync is bi-directional or covers issues specifically. A full two-way sync appears to need custom work on the REST API, which can create and update databases and pages (notion-docs-1), plus webhooks for page and property changes (notion-docs-3, notion-docs-20). An older community complaint about a missing GitHub integration (notion-comm-7) predates the current listing and does not concretely contradict it. missing for 10: documented bi-directional issue↔task sync, details of field mapping and conflict handling, support for other issue trackers, independent hands-on corroboration.
